briefdescription.para: Implementation of the ablation study framework (EPIC 2 Phase 2).

detaileddescription.para: Implements AblationRunner and the AblationReport helper methods declared in ablation_framework.h.

sect2.title: Execution model
sect2.para: For each registered experiment, the runner iterates over the query batch and applies the following logic per query:

listitem.para: Adjust the query snapshot to simulate the configured freshness variant (fresh vs stale).
Compute retrieval quality metrics via computeRetrievalQuality().
Record the adjusted snapshot in a MetricCollector.
After all queries, aggregate via MetricCollector::summarizeTensorGraph().

sect2.para: Per-query MetricError exceptions are caught and recorded in AblationResult::per_query_errors; they do not abort the experiment.

listitem.para: GPU requested but unavailable: experiment runs on CPU and sets AblationResult::gpu_fallback_occurred = true.
Stale freshness variant: snapshot.artifact_age_ms is replaced with config.stale_artifact_age_ms. When stale_artifact_age_ms is not set (== 0), a default 10× freshness threshold is used.
Unrecovered summary-first false negatives: detected per snapshot and aggregated into AblationResult::has_unrecovered_false_negatives.
Unsafe residual: any snapshot with residual_error > max_residual sets AblationResult::has_unsafe_residual = true.
